title: cynanchum schlechtendalii
intro: Cynanchum schlechtendalii, commonly known as Asian Swallowwort, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum schlechtendalii include its ability to act as an antipyretic, expectorant, and cough suppressant, making it useful in treating respiratory infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
